title: Elf Bar 600 Snoow Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Snoow Tobacco Prefilled Pods are designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, bringing a familiar yet distinctive tobacco vape. Each pod carries 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs with a smooth MTL draw. The flavour combines the rich, earthy taste of classic Tobacco with a mellow, creamy note for a satisfying and rounded vape. Pods can be switched out quickly, ensuring mess-free and straightforward vaping.
